title: Iran’s security chief Rezaei says Putin ‘VERY STRONGLY AND FIRMLY CONDEMNED the military attacks of the US and Israel on Iran’
text:
Iran’s security chief Rezaei says Putin ‘VERY STRONGLY AND FIRMLY CONDEMNED the military attacks of the US and Israel on Iran’"

"‘Until the Americans fulfill our SEVEN CONDITIONS, neither will the STRAIT OF HORMUZ be opened, nor will there be any negotiations’
